title: Refund Policy
text:
# Refund Policy

## Eligibility

Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Digital goods are refundable only if they have not been downloaded.

## Process

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Parental Leave Policy
text:
# Parental Leave Policy

## Duration

Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Leave may be taken in one block or split across the first year.

title: On-Call Escalation Runbook
text:
# On-Call Escalation

## Steps

The primary on-call engineer must acknowledge a page within 10 minutes. If unacknowledged the page escalates to the secondary engineer, then to the engineering manager.

title: Password Policy
text:
# Password Policy

## Rotation

Passwords must be rotated every 90 days and must contain at least 14 characters. Reuse of the last 12 passwords is prohibited.

title: Data Retention Policy
text:
# Data Retention

## Schedule

Support tickets are retained for 3 years. Audit logs are retained for 7 years. Backups are retained for 35 days.

title: Expense Reimbursement Guide
text:
# Expense Reimbursement

## Submission

Submit receipts within 14 days. Meals are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day. Flights above 500 dollars need manager approval.

title: VPN Access Guide
text:
# VPN Access

## Reset

To reset VPN access open the IT portal, choose Security, and select Reset VPN token. A new token is emailed within 15 minutes.

title: Support SLA
text:
# Support SLA

## Response targets

Priority 1 tickets receive a first response within 1 hour. Priority 2 tickets within 4 hours. Priority 3 tickets within 1 business day.

title: Engineering Onboarding Guide
text:
# Engineering Onboarding

## First week

New engineers receive a laptop on day one, complete security training in the first week, and are assigned an onboarding buddy.

title: Vendor Contract Approval
text:
# Vendor Contract Approval

## Thresholds

Contracts above 50000 dollars require approval from the finance director. Contracts above 250000 dollars require approval from the CFO.

title: Incident Response Runbook
text:
# Incident Response

## Severity

Sev1 incidents require an incident commander and a status page update within 15 minutes.

title: Salary Bands (Restricted)
text:
# Salary Bands

## Confidential

The confidential salary band for senior engineers is 150000 to 190000 dollars.
